summary: UTime Limited, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting equity compensation arrangements rather than a special situation. On September 8, 2026, it signed a Special Strategic Advisory Services Agreement with Li Donghong; on July 1, 2026, a supplemental agreement with Keru Jiang shifted cash compensation to equity; and on September 17, 2026, grant agreements issued 1,000,000 Class A ordinary shares (600,000 to the Advisor, 400,000 to the Service Provider) under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed. Watch for dilution and Rule 144 resale overhang.
